name: factuez-grifo-san-jose
description: Sistema de Facturación para Grifo San José basado en FactuEz

scripts.test:history-persistence: pnpm --filter @factuez/history-core build && vitest run --maxWorkers=4 tests/history-full-contract.spec.ts tests/history-archive-access.spec.ts tests/history-archive-storage.spec.ts tests/history-archive-repository.spec.ts
scripts.test:history-read: pnpm --filter @factuez/history-core build && vitest run --maxWorkers=4 tests/history-read-api.spec.ts tests/history-read-identity.spec.ts tests/history-reconciliation.spec.ts tests/history-archive-repository.spec.ts
scripts.test:shadow: pnpm --filter @factuez/shadow-core... build && vitest run --maxWorkers=4 tests/shadow-core.spec.ts tests/shadow-cli.spec.ts tests/shadow-review.spec.ts
scripts.test:shadow-panel: pnpm --filter @factuez/shadow-core... build && vitest run --maxWorkers=4 tests/shadow-panel.spec.ts tests/shadow-panel-ui.spec.ts
scripts.test:evidence: pnpm --filter @factuez/evidence-core... build && vitest run --maxWorkers=4 tests/evidence-xml.spec.ts tests/evidence-reconciliation.spec.ts tests/evidence-crypto.spec.ts tests/evidence-pdf.spec.ts tests/evidence-cli.spec.ts
scripts.qa:evidence: pnpm --filter @factuez/evidence-core... build && pnpm --filter @factuez/pdf-renderer... build && node migration/evidence-qa-cli.cjs --isolated-synthetic-only
scripts.qa:history:persistence: pnpm --filter @factuez/history-core build && pnpm --filter @factuez/history-service db:generate && pnpm --filter @factuez/history-service build && node tests/history-archive-db.e2e.mjs --isolated-synthetic-only
